evaluation.primary: Player-count-equal normalized rank score (players-rank)/(players-1); equal-strength reference 0.5
secondary: actual elapsed search time and simulations by side and phase
evaluation.uncertainty: 100000 bootstrap resamples of whole seed blocks after all 84 games finish. No benefit does not prove equivalence or an incorrect algorithm direction.

caveat: One current-version seat vs original-version opponents, everyone 2000ms; all seeds/seats predeclared. Parallel load affects throughput; timings compare different encountered positions. No outcome-dependent stopping.
